title: Compiling
body:
Both [[Interpriting]] and Compiling languages are converted to [[Machine Language]] 
[[INTRODUCTION TO COMPUTER SCIENCE 2]] Is a compiled language.

hello.cpp -> g++ -> a.out 

`g++ file_name.cpp` 
writes a file called **a.out**

`g++ file_name.cpp -o program_name`
writes a file called **program_name.out**

***NEVER do this***
`g++ hello.cpp -o hello.cpp`
This will rewrite the working file with the compiled program.
